title: Super Mario Bros 3 PC Prototype from id Software
summary: A short clip of the Super Mario Bros 3 proof-of-concept PC port built by id Software's founders to pitch Nintendo on a PC version. Nintendo passed, and the same technology led to Commander Keen.
why: Cited as footage of a famous piece of gaming history whenever id Software, Commander Keen, or scrolling tech comes up.

quote.text: They actually did a port of SMB3 and presented that to Nintendo.
